route_name: FEMA Region 3 REP / FEMA FOIA route
what_it_can_do: request or locate FEMA REP preliminary findings, ANS demonstration records, final report/AAR-IP path, transmittal route
what_it_cannot_do: prove BVPS exercise readiness or ANS performance
current_route_note: Use official FEMA/DHS FOIA/public-affairs route; verify current submission channel immediately before sending.

route_name: Pennsylvania Office of Open Records / PEMA RTKL route
what_it_can_do: support RTKL request route for PEMA/Pennsylvania offsite REP records and appeal path if denied or deemed denied
what_it_cannot_do: supply local evaluated-performance proof by itself
current_route_note: PA OOR standard request form/portal context; agency-specific officer/channel must be verified before sending.

what_it_can_do: request county EMA/EOC/JIC/ANS/AFN records if held by Beaver County
what_it_cannot_do: prove evaluated delivery, accessibility, or county performance absent produced records
current_route_note: County open-records page is a route; target records must be specific existing records, not questions.

what_it_can_do: support Ohio/Columbiana state-level records route and help locate state EMA-held drill/evaluation artifacts
what_it_cannot_do: substitute for county-held logs or FEMA evaluator findings
current_route_note: Ohio EMA public-records page defines public-record route; Columbiana county route may still be needed for county-held records.

route_name: NRC FOIA / Public Document Room route
what_it_can_do: request or route regulatory records, inspection follow-up, LER/no-LER disposition, and PDR assistance
what_it_cannot_do: show EOF recovery unless actual records are produced and admissible
current_route_note: Use current NRC FOIA/PDR route; pair with ADAMS Public Search/PDR help because Web-Based ADAMS is retired.

route_name: NRC ADAMS Public Documents / access transition
what_it_can_do: identify that Web-Based ADAMS was retired and route users toward current ADAMS/PDR support for accession searches
what_it_cannot_do: serve as a BVPS LER, inspection, or repair record by itself
current_route_note: Treat old ADAMS search recipes as stale; capture accession IDs and PDR route metadata when found.

route_name: Licensee/regulatory public route for Vistra/BVPS records
what_it_can_do: stage specific requests for licensee records or obtain them through regulator/public channels
what_it_cannot_do: oblige disclosure through this static cube or close EOF/ANS claims without records
current_route_note: Do not send speculative broad requests; use scoped artifact classes and regulator route when needed.
